slot.brief: Identify which hydride is ionic / which reacts with water liberating H2; simple classification of NaH, CH4, HCl type species.

stem: Which hydride is ionic and liberates hydrogen gas when it reacts with water?

verdicts.working: NaH is an ionic hydride and reacts with water: NaH + H₂O → NaOH + H₂.

working:
$\text{NaH}+\text{H}_2\text{O}\rightarrow\text{NaOH}+\text{H}_2\uparrow$

Independent check: NaH is an ionic hydride and reacts with water: NaH + H₂O → NaOH + H₂.
solution:
Ionic hydrides react with water to liberate hydrogen gas. For sodium hydride,
$$\text{NaH}+\text{H}_2\text{O}\rightarrow\text{NaOH}+\text{H}_2\uparrow$$
Hence, $\text{NaH}$ is the required hydride.
